summary: Thomson Reuters' subsidiary TR Finance LLC priced and sold $1.3bn of senior unsecured notes under an underwriting agreement dated September 10, 2026, disclosed via a Form 6-K filed September 14, 2026 (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K/424B shelf takedown). The offering comprises $800m of 5.100% senior notes due 2028 and $500m of 5.750% senior notes due 2033. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by Thomson Reuters Corporation and listed subsidiary guarantors, under a March 2025 base indenture. This is a routine debt capital-markets financing with no special-situation element.
